content:
The **Salvaged Assaultron Head** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

This salvaged head of an Assaultron is fired like a non-automatic energy pistol. Reloading repeatedly increases the amount of charges, and thus, the damage.

When fired, the weapon irradiates the user. The self-damage is the same regardless of the number of charges or weapon level. It deals either 25 or 50 ![Radiation Damage Radiation Damage](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6a/Icon_radiation.png/14px-Icon_radiation.png) Radiation Exposure damage via enchantment.

 [1] 

The weapon has a hidden passive ability that will allow it to reduce every target to ash. [2] The range is also a fixed value.

Aside from Legendary Crafting, the Salvaged Assaultron Head cannot be modified in any way.

## Locations[edit]

- One can be found at the Pioneer Scout Camp, on a shelf in the archery range.
- One can sometimes be found on dead Assaultrons.

- Affected by the Grounded mutation.
- The projectile creates a small, cosmetic explosion upon impact.

### Changelog[edit]

- No longer spawns with the explosive legendary prefix. Explosive assaultron heads are considered Legacy Content.
- Crafting is no longer affected by Super Duper. Prior to this, it could be used to duplicate Screws.
- PC![PC](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e3/Icon_pc.png/14px-Icon_pc.png) Playstation 4 ![Playstation 4](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6f/Icon_ps4.png/18px-Icon_ps4.png) Prior to patch 1.1.0.8, the salvaged Assaultron head could only fire a single shot that consumed all fusion cells in the player character's inventory. **[Patched]** 
- PC![PC](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e3/Icon_pc.png/14px-Icon_pc.png) Xbox One ![Xbox One](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/e/e2/Icon_xboxone.png/14px-Icon_xboxone.png) Playstation 4 ![Playstation 4](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/6/6f/Icon_ps4.png/18px-Icon_ps4.png) This weapon works really well with the quad legendary effect. However, some players have reported that the gun is extremely bugged and does almost no damage, regardless of how many charges are fired, even if it is a quad-explosive. **[Patched]**
